name: Simpliciter
description: Connect Simpliciter to Claude for source-grounded legal research directly in your conversations. Use your Simpliciter account to discover available legal sources, run semantic research across the databases enabled for your plan, and retrieve specific statutes, case law, administrative guidance, or other legal materials by exact reference.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Simpliciter to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Simpliciter to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://simpliciter.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Simpliciter MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Simpliciter provides these MCP tools: fetch_legal_source, legal_research, and list_available_sources.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Simpliciter?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Simpliciter in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.
Simpliciter requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Simpliciter is developed by Simpliciter.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
